mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth declines by > 2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series is rising and the unemployment rate is falling, it signals a strengthening consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST is rising and UNRATE is falling.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is rising and payroll employment is falling, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is rising and PAYEMS is falling.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising and the consumer price index is accelerating, it signals a tightening monetary cycle with rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL is accelerating.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real estate loans signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines by > 5% y/y.
